newsitem.title: USA: Magainin gets $5 mln milestone payment.
newsitem.headline: Magainin gets $5 mln milestone payment.

text.p: Magainin Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday that it has received a $5 million milestone payment from SmithKline Beecham Plc related to a development, supply and distribution agreement for Cytolex.

The milestone reflects successful completion of clinical testing of Cytolex, and SmithKline's determination that there is sufficient clinical data to support the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's acceptance of a New Drug Application for Cytolex, it said.
To date, SmithKline has paid Magainin $10 million under the agreement, having also provided a $5 million upfront payment in February 1997.
SmithKline may make additional payments to Magainin of up to $22.5 million for other product milestones.
Cytolex is a broad-spectrum topical antibiotic cream intended for the treatment of infection in diabetic foot ulcers.
Magainin has completed two successful Phase III clinical trials of Cytolex.
